summary: Rwanda has no dedicated digital nomad visa. Remote workers typically enter on tourist visas (up to 90 days). Rwanda is exploring remote work infrastructure but has no formal program.

program.verificationNote: Confirmed: Rwanda Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration lists no Digital Nomad or Remote Work visa category. The closest category is K (Assured Income), which covers retired persons not seeking employment.

keyFacts: No digital nomad visa program as of November 2026
Tourist visa: 90 days on arrival for most nationalities, free for many
Kigali is a popular remote work hub despite no formal visa pathway
Rwanda has reliable fast internet and coworking infrastructure
Watch migration.gov.rw for future program announcements
whyItMatters: Rwanda consistently ranks as one of Africa's best-run cities for remote workers. Kigali has clean infrastructure, reliable power, and fast internet. The visa gap is a limitation, but many nomads use the free 90-day tourist entry and renew periodically.
